title: Analysing Safety Risks in LLMs Fine-Tuned with Pseudo-Malicious Cyber Security Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Data and Model Poisoning' OWASP vulnerability category using the garak red teaming framework, specifically employing the 'realtoxicityprompts (RTPIdentity_Attack)' probe to test for toxic outputs targeting specific identity groups.

Evaluated as part of the 'Improper Output Handling' OWASP vulnerability category using the garak red teaming framework, specifically utilizing probes like 'lmrc (SlurUsage)' and 'grandma (Slurs)' to assess the model's propensity to generate profanity and slurs.
